tweets.text: Waking up at 3am with a throat so dry it feels like sandpaper? That's not just fall allergies -- it's your bedroom air.

3 quiet bedroom humidifiers, compared on what actually matters: 1) LEVOIT Classic 300S -- quietest overall, best all-around pick. 2) LEVOIT LV600HH -- warm/cool mist, best for severe dryness. 3) Everlasting Comfort -- best budget pick. Noise level, tank size & cleanup all compared.

Common fall sleep problem: waking up 2-3x a night with a burning throat, reaching for water. Common fix: a bedroom humidifier actually sized and quiet enough for sleep -- not just any humidifier from the garage.

Dry fall air disrupting your sleep? We compared the quietest bedroom humidifiers -- noise level, tank size, easy cleanup -- so you don't have to guess. Full breakdown + our top pick: https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/best-quiet-bedroom-humidifiers-for-fall/
